inventory.notes: Initial partial atomic-feature map, not full Java/JDK conformance. Exact historical owned native source/objects/executables and same-original JDK results support the four bounded runtime rows. Unit/program rows intentionally refer to the same real compilation/execution assertion test and raw program outputs, never pytest aggregate stdout. Reproduction commands omit sandbox paths. JDK observers normalize return values to declared primitive raw lanes. Source model native gates stay explicit; current candidate reference disagreement is retained. Frozen class/JAR experiments are excluded from source acceptance. Many already implemented scalar/source-closure features still need normalized rows, not presumed absent. Four bounded runtime rows now also have NEW actual raw-process comparisons from c5; historical normalized observations remain separate and are not relabeled. The new lane selects an explicit existing JDK executable via PCC_JAVA_RAW_REFERENCE; actual gate used JDK21 and source/target21, not Mac JDK17. One executable assertion test supplies both unit and program evidence for each unchanged original, not fabricated compile-only outputs.

features.title: Standalone primitive conditional operator
features.scope: JLS 15.25: boolean/integral standalone ?: typing, narrowing, one selected arm, source DA. Excludes reference/poly/boxing operands. New c5 reference gate directly compares actual stdout/stderr/exit for an unchanged representative original; broader existing authored corpus remains separately qualified.

features.title: Integral division by nonzero constant divisor
features.scope: JLS 15.17.2-3: int/long constant nonzero divisors, truncation, remainder and MIN/-1. Dynamic or zero divisors are a distinct unimplemented exception feature. New c5 reference gate directly compares actual stdout/stderr/exit for an unchanged representative original; broader existing authored corpus remains separately qualified.

features.title: Primitive switch statements
features.scope: JLS 14.11,16.2.9: byte/short/char/int selector statements, constant colon/arrow labels, break/continue and DA. Excludes switch expressions, enum/reference/pattern selectors. New c5 reference gate directly compares actual stdout/stderr/exit for an unchanged representative original; broader existing authored corpus remains separately qualified.

features.title: Primitive do-while statements
features.scope: JLS 14.13,16.2.11: post-test boolean control, body-once, continue-to-test, break and local DA. No exception/monitor completion edges. New c5 reference gate directly compares actual stdout/stderr/exit for an unchanged representative original; broader existing authored corpus remains separately qualified.

features.title: Managed objects and constructor execution
features.scope: JLS 4.3.1,8.8,12.5,15.9. Native compile_source(s) rejects explicit instance features. Class-model API is not an allocator/GC/dispatch substitute.

features.title: Array allocation and access
features.scope: JLS 10,15.10. No Java array allocation, runtime length/bounds/store checks, roots or reference tracing. Dedicated feature-specific diagnostic mapping is also missing; generic unsupported token/expression errors are not counted as this feature diagnostic.

features.title: Unicode escape translation
features.scope: JLS 3.3. Input containing Unicode-escape translation is rejected, not preprocessed by javac.

features.title: Strings and text blocks
features.scope: JLS 3.10.5-6,4.3.3. No String allocation, interning, concatenation or text-block implementation. Dedicated feature-specific diagnostic mapping is also missing; generic unsupported token/expression errors are not counted as this feature diagnostic.

features.title: Runtime ArithmeticException for integer division
features.scope: JLS 15.17.2-3. Zero or nonconstant divisor explicitly rejected before IR; no trap substituted for Java exception.

features.title: Nonconstant static initialization
features.scope: JLS 8.7,12.4. Mutable/static initializer/cyclic constant dependencies require shared initialization state and exceptions.

features.title: Blank final local definite unassignment
features.scope: JLS 4.12.4,14.4,16. Initialized final locals exist; blank final local statements remain rejected.

features.title: Static and on-demand import resolution
features.scope: JLS 7.5.2-4. Single-type imports are a separate admitted slice; these forms explicitly rejected.

features.title: Complete implicit java.lang type metadata
features.scope: JLS 7.3,6.5. Unknown package-qualified roots rejected rather than guessing that absent standard classes are packages.

features.title: Inheritance and generic class declaration
features.scope: JLS 8.1.2,8.1.4-5. No inheritance, generic instantiation, interface implementation or Object override conformance.

features.title: Nested class types
features.scope: JLS 8.5. Member type lookup explicitly rejected.

features.title: Reference and boxed conditional operands
features.scope: JLS 15.25. Reference/poly/boxing ?: operands require separate type and runtime domains.

features.title: Switch expressions and reference/pattern labels
features.scope: JLS 15.28. Expression switch and null/reference/pattern selectors rejected, not rewritten to primitive statement switch. Dedicated feature-specific diagnostic mapping is also missing; generic unsupported token/expression errors are not counted as this feature diagnostic.

features.title: Full Java main startup and other targets
features.scope: JLS 12.1. Tiny native startup requires ()I and Linux ELF; not main(String[]) or a platform Java launcher.

features.title: Additional declaration types
features.scope: byte/short/char locals/parameters/results and float/double are outside the current boolean/int/long/void source declaration slice.

features.title: Class and constructor typed semantic model
features.scope: Model-only API checks fields/receiver/constructor/initializers. 971 model has actual semantic/typecheck qualification, but no native constructor execution; not runtime supported.

features.title: Blank final instance-field DA/DU model
features.scope: Candidate1eb has 69 focused and1111 whole PCC tests, but strict JDK21 comparison35positive/33negative/1disagreement. Unpublished; no native instance execution. JLS8.3.1.2,16.2.10-12,16.9.

features.title: Java memory model and final-field freeze
features.scope: Shared-runtime prerequisite. No monitor/volatile/thread/final-field-freeze execution qualification.

features.title: Java exception propagation and cleanup
features.scope: Shared Throwable/unwind integration absent; no broad exception conformance.

features.title: Interfaces and annotation types
features.scope: Not covered by current static-method source slice or a precise full-feature diagnostic taxonomy.

features.title: Java binary compatibility contract
features.scope: Frozen class compatibility experiment is not source project/linker binary compatibility qualification.

features.title: Java module graph
features.scope: No Java module-system source project resolution.

Both lanes preserve identical original source bytes.
